native_proof.collection_chain: BODY trailer ->typed collection equals explicit native mapping owner. Collection->mapping is reciprocal; repeated memberlists omit BODY. Collection context and footer independently reference same typed component.
native_proof.creator_chain: Unique typed D263 anchor ->BODY and creator. Known Extrude@151/SurfacePatch@75 single-anchor table reciprocates that exact anchor; bounded following metadata UUID is checked.
native_proof.dependency_chain: Fresh dependency decode validates forward/reverse edge multisets; source creator->scope datum edge4096 resolves to typed component. Collection component and creator scope must agree.

limitations: Only observed Extrude and SurfacePatch single-result-anchor layouts are supported; other creators and ambiguous anchors remain unresolved.
Absent membership stays absent; this does not restore removed/consumed bodies to current collections.
No active/current/final body role, PM/DM source identity, suppression/rollback lifetime or general assembly-state solving is inferred.
Stored cache placement in the corroborated component does not replay that component occurrence history.
Independent API removal/result counts describe features, not a complete native-ID lifecycle oracle.
